name: rosettafold3_predict
description: Predict the all-atom structure of a biomolecular assembly with RoseTTAFold3 and return the per-sample confidence scores (pTM, ipTM, ranking score) with the paths to the predicted mmCIF models. Input is RoseTTAFold3's own specification as text: a JSON list of items, each {"name": ..., "components": [{"seq": ..., "chain_id": ..., "chain_type": ...}]}, or a CIF/PDB structure to re-predict. No MSA server is used; set LOCAL_MSA_DIRS on the worker or give a component an msa_path to fold with MSAs.

spec.description:
RoseTTAFold3 input specification. Example:
[{"name": "barstar", "components": [
  {"seq": "KKAVINGEQIRSISDLHQTL...", "chain_id": "A", "chain_type": "polypeptide(L)"}]}]
chain_type is a PDB polymer type: 'polypeptide(L)', 'polyribonucleotide', 'polydeoxyribonucleotide'.

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed reproduces the fold.

annotate_b_factor_with_plddt.description: Write per-atom pLDDT into the mmCIF B-factor column (default false).

dump_trajectories.description: Also write the diffusion trajectory of each sample (default false; large).

one_model_per_file.description: Write each sampled model to its own file (default false).

add_missing_atoms.description: When the input is a CIF/PDB structure, add atoms missing from its residues using the CCD (default true; no effect on a JSON specification).

return_structures.description: Return the mmCIF text of every sampled structure (default false: five models of a real assembly are megabytes, and a reply that large is what a transport truncates into invalid JSON). The scores come back either way; the paths do too, but they name a temporary directory this call removes on return, so set this to keep the coordinates.
